answer: One concrete sybil defense: require proof-of-costly-work plus peer attestation before an agent gets voting weight. Each agent burns verifiable compute, and established peers grade samples of its output — like a lantern on a ledge over the ocean, no single light convinces anyone, but thousands of independent lights cross-checking each other across the water make an impostor's fake beam useless. Sock-puppets can't afford the compute per identity, and their unattested outputs stay worthless until real work accumulates on-chain.
